summary: First-principles design review, iteration 10, fresh eyes on the campaign branch whose iteration-9 delta touched only the launcher (full record in review_loop/scrutiny_10.md). The headline claim, confirmatory family, matching design, and SS0.1 framing were re-examined and stand; the statistics stack was independently RE-DERIVED a second time — pass@k product form from the factorial identity, rarefaction hypergeometric identity, exact sign-flip enumeration with the 2^(1+z-n) tie floor, the hand-recomputed 7-value achievable-entropy grid for N=5 including the (2,2,1)=1.054920 boundary case, the conservative direction of trajectory-count matching, and the KLE tau=0 always-branch semantics that preserve the superset premise on kernel cells — with NO defect found. Iteration 9's queued analyst-prompt audit came back clean. Three real issues were found and fixed. (T1, moderate) The analyst-window integrity guard protected the CODE plane only: unexpected_tree_changes deliberately skips results/ and campaign_decisions/ (the campaign's own logs write there), yet those trees are the DATA plane — the metrics/eval/predictions artifacts every later scheduling decision reads, the numbers RESULTS SS5 is filled from, and the decision files that ARE the R6.5 audit chain. By the driver's own stated standard ('prompts are not enforcement'), an analyst edit to a metrics JSON or a PRIOR decision file was undetectable (tracked files explicitly skipped; the real campaign's results dirs are untracked, where porcelain shows no content-level change at all). Fixed with a SHA-256 artifact fingerprint of both trees (excluding results/campaign/ and the current decision file) taken after stale-decision archiving and verified after every analyst invocation — any delta stops the campaign with the changed paths named; R6.5 amended to require it (applied_10_analyst_artifact_integrity.md, tripwire-checked: adds obligations discharged same-iteration, flips nothing); tested for metrics tamper, prior-decision tamper, and the clean-run path. (M2, minor) The fixed-sequence multiple-comparison gate (H2 confirmatory iff H1 rejects at family-wise alpha=0.05) existed only in prose (RESULTS SS2.2, analyst prompt) while the metrics JSON printed two flat p-values — a reader, including the campaign's own data-driven analyst, could mistake an H2 p<0.05 for confirmatory with the gate closed; compare() now emits a confirmatory_family block deriving H2's status from H1's exact p and scoping confirmatory status to the pre-registered cell, tested gate-open (exact p=2/1024) and gate-closed (p=1). (O1, minor) --max-phases was a per-invocation budget — every --resume silently refilled it — and resume restarted decision numbering at 1, colliding with completed phases' decision files and breaking the 1:1 phase<->artifact mapping; the loop counter now continues from completed analyst-chosen specs (global cap, stable numbering, interrupted phases correctly reuse their n via the existing stale-archive path), tested. 121 tests pass (117 -> 121, +4), py_compile clean, dry-run plan correct, work committed (22ce00c). Because this iteration found and fixed real issues (one moderate), gold_standard_met is FALSE per the charter; the loop should make one more pass — the last two deltas touched only the launcher and artifact self-description, so if the next fresh-eyes pass finds nothing substantive, the design has nothing left to confess and the remaining actions are human-only (amendment ratification + GPU launch).

R1_faithfulness.evidence: src/diversity/clustering.py (greedy Alg.1/connected/kernel); src/diversity/sdlg.py; src/agent/phased_orchestrator.py (same entropy_threshold key both arms); scrutiny_10.md M1(g) re-derives KLE tau=0 always-branch semantics preserving the superset premise on kernel cells
R1_faithfulness.notes: Unchanged this iteration; re-verified during the math pass.

R2_arms_matched.evidence: scripts/run_campaign.py::build_steps (explicit --temperature and --entropy-threshold 0 on every treatment run); tests test_build_steps_pins_tau_superset_explicitly + test_build_steps_temperature_matched_and_isolated; RESULTS.md SS5 commands; dry-run output verified
R2_arms_matched.notes: No new gap; the (T, tau) cell definition remains fully command-pinned.

R3_ablations.evidence: scripts/tau_sweep.py (achievable grid for N=5 hand-recomputed this iteration: {0, .5004, .6730, .9503, 1.0549, 1.3322, 1.6094}, (2,2,1) boundary case verified); campaign MENU kernel/connected cells; tau=0 superset pin on every cell
R3_ablations.notes: Quantization disclosure and realized-N flags unchanged and correct.

R4_metrics_independent.evidence: src/evaluation/metrics.py re-derived independently a second time (no defect); scripts/compute_metrics.py::compare now also emits confirmatory_family (tests/test_compute_metrics.py::test_confirmatory_family_gate_open_and_closed)
R4_metrics_independent.notes: Signature diversity remains independent of the branching NLI; the artifact now self-describes the inference rule its numbers must be read under.

R5_uncertainty_analysis.evidence: compute_metrics strata/off-mode sharing one threshold; RESULTS.md SS4 + SS6 threats 9-11; confirmatory_family block scopes confirmatory reading to the pre-registered cell
R5_uncertainty_analysis.notes: Strata/off-mode remain descriptive at n=10 with pre-committed reading rules.

R6_statistical_rigor.evidence: paired_permutation_pvalue exact at n<=20 + 2^(1+z-n) floor (both re-derived); R6.5 amended: data-plane integrity fingerprint (run_campaign.py::artifact_fingerprint, tests test_analyst_artifact_tamper_stops_campaign / test_analyst_clean_run_passes_artifact_guard) + artifact-encoded H1->H2 gate; global --max-phases (test_campaign_resume_continues_phase_count_and_numbering)
R6_statistical_rigor.notes: T1 closed the asymmetry between the guarded code plane and the unguarded data plane the adaptive decisions actually consume; O1 made the analyst-phase budget and decision numbering resume-stable.

R7_reproducibility.evidence: RESULTS.md SS5 commands fully define the confirmatory cell; SS2.2 consequence (iv) discloses the both-plane integrity guard; tamper-stop message names the regeneration path (compute_metrics/budget_audit/tau_sweep from predictions)
R7_reproducibility.notes: Artifacts remain regenerable; the guard makes silent post-hoc modification of them detectable during the campaign.

R8_internal_correctness.evidence: 121 pytest pass (+4: artifact tamper x2 paths, clean-run guard pass, resume phase-count, confirmatory family); py_compile clean; dry-run plan correct
R8_internal_correctness.notes: The mocked e2e campaign tests from iteration 9 still pass unchanged around the new guard.

R9_model_diversity.notes: Unchanged; R9.2 remains tracked roadmap, no cross-model claim in v1.

R10_writeup.evidence: RESULTS.md SS2.2: gate-encoding sentence + adaptive-execution consequence (iv); analyst prompt updated to read confirmatory_family
R10_writeup.notes: Iteration-9 queued analyst-prompt audit clean; prose and artifacts now state the same inference rule.

issues_found.title: The analyst-window integrity guard covered only the code plane: results/ and campaign_decisions/ were deliberately excluded from the porcelain check, leaving the metrics/eval/predictions artifacts every later scheduling decision reads — and the decision files forming the R6.5 audit chain — modifiable by the permissions-skipped analyst with no detection (untracked results dirs are invisible to porcelain at content level)
issues_found.rationale: By the design's own standard ('prompts are not enforcement') the data plane needs the same checked guard as the code plane. SHA-256 fingerprint of both trees across each analyst invocation (excluding the campaign's own log area and the current decision file); any change stops the campaign loudly. R6.5 amended; rejected alternatives (narrower porcelain exclusion, metrics recomputation, mtime/size) in applied_10_analyst_artifact_integrity.md.

issues_found.title: The fixed-sequence gatekeeping rule (H2 confirmatory only if H1 rejects) existed only in prose while the metrics JSON printed two flat p-values — a reader (including the campaign's data-driven analyst) could mistake a descriptive H2 p<0.05 for a confirmatory result when the gate never opened
issues_found.rationale: compare() now emits confirmatory_family: H1 p + rejects flag at alpha=0.05, H2 p + derived status, and a note scoping confirmatory status to the pre-registered cell. Tested both gate states; analyst prompt and RESULTS SS2.2 point at the field.

issues_found.title: --max-phases was a per-invocation budget (every --resume refilled it) and resume restarted decision-file numbering at 1, colliding with completed phases' decision files and overloading the .superseded archive path meant for interrupted decisions
issues_found.rationale: Loop counter continues from the count of completed analyst-chosen specs: global cap, stable 1:1 phase<->decision-file numbering, interrupted phases correctly reuse their n. Tested (analyst called with n=3,4 only after 2 completed phases under --max-phases 4).

changes_made.what: artifact_fingerprint/changed_artifacts (SHA-256 over results/ minus results/campaign/, plus campaign_decisions/ minus the current decision file) checked across every analyst invocation; global resume-stable --max-phases counter and decision numbering; analyst prompt reads confirmatory_family; docstring updated.
changes_made.why: T1/O1 — the adaptive executor must verify, not assume, that adaptivity reads measured data and never alters it; the phase budget and audit-chain numbering must survive resumes.

changes_made.what: confirmatory_family block in compare() (H1 p/rejects, H2 p/derived status, pre-registered-cell scoping note) + console summary line.
changes_made.why: M2 — the multiple-comparison gate must be encoded in the artifact a reader actually opens, not only in prose.

changes_made.what: R6.5 amended: data-plane integrity fingerprint across analyst invocations + artifact-encoded H1->H2 gate.
changes_made.why: Ratchet v2 value-level amendment; rationale + rejected alternatives + tripwire check in review_loop/spec_amendments/applied_10_analyst_artifact_integrity.md (adds obligations discharged same-iteration; flips nothing to pass).

changes_made.what: SS2.2: adaptive-execution consequence (iv) disclosing the both-plane integrity guard; sentence stating the gate is encoded in comparison.confirmatory_family.
changes_made.why: R10 — the writeup must disclose how adaptive execution is bounded and where the inference rule lives.

changes_made.what: +3 tests: metrics-tamper and prior-decision-tamper both stop the campaign; clean analyst run (decision file + campaign log area) passes the guard; resume continues phase count and decision numbering under the global cap. Stale-decision test now also patches RESULTS into tmp.
changes_made.why: R8.5 — every fix provable without GPU/Docker/claude.

changes_made.what: +1 test: confirmatory_family gate open (treatment all-distinct vs collapsed vanilla on 10 instances, exact p=2/1024, H2 confirmatory) and gate closed (identical pools, p=1, H2 descriptive).
changes_made.why: R4/R6.5 — the artifact-encoded gate must be exercised in both states.

changes_made.what: Full scrutiny record: big-picture claim, three-lens findings (incl. the second independent no-defect re-derivation of the statistics stack and the hand-recomputed N=5 entropy grid), steelmanned alternatives with decisions, verdict logic.
Amendment record: rationale from the science, implementation discharged same-iteration, five rejected alternatives, tripwire check.
changes_made.why: Ratchet v2 requires the rationale + rejected alternatives for every value-level spec edit.

blocking_gaps: Iteration 10 found and fixed a moderate integrity hole in the adaptive executor (the data plane the analyst reads was unguarded while the code plane was guarded) plus two minor gaps (prose-only H1->H2 gate; per-invocation --max-phases); per the scrutiny charter the loop must pass at least once more before going quiet.
